verdict.rationale: Skyfire documents its own settlement flow for agent payments. Sellers charge pay tokens, Skyfire moves funds between buyer and seller wallets with stated timing windows (up to 51 hours), and a wallet balance API exposes available, held and pending amounts. However, payout off-platform and reconciliation-grade reporting are not documented, and funds settle into a Skyfire-specific wallet rather than an existing merchant channel. Missing for 10: documented payout to bank/processor accounts, transaction-level reporting or export for reconciliation, integration with existing merchant settlement channels, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a merchant, agent-originated payments settle through documented payout and reporting flows, reconcilable like any other channel

citations.quote: For paid services, the seller charges the token and Skyfire moves the funds between the buyer's and seller's wallets.
Settlement may take up to 51 hours depending on token expiration and charging activity.
Skyfire enforces this obligation to guarantee settlement
